title: Recording Attended Program Days — Workers' Compensation Referral Work Conditioning and Work Hardening
content:
# Recording attended program days

**Rule.** Every program day a worker attends in an hour-billed program of the Workers' Compensation Referral — the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program — is recorded on the referral against the adjuster authorization in force, drawing one authorized program day, while the referral is in referral received or active status.

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| What is recorded | each attended program day of an hour-billed program |
| Recorded on | the worker's referral for that program |
| Drawn on | the adjuster authorization in force on the referral |
| Effect on the authorization | one authorized program day is drawn |
| Referral status in which it is recorded | referral received or active |

## Recording a program day: `record_program_day_6fda50ae`

**Capability.** One call adds one recorded program day to the referral's history: the date of service, the program hours recorded for that day and the authorization reference it is drawn on. The day draws one authorized program day, so the referral's count of authorized program days still unused goes down by one. Nothing is billed by this action.

**Invocation.** `record_program_day_6fda50ae` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wc_case_id` | the reference number of the workers' compensation referral the program day belongs to, as returned by the referral lookup | identifier |
| `appointment_date` | the date of service of the attended program day | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date in the clinic's local time zone; no empty value |
| `units` | the program hours recorded for the day | non-negative integer of whole hours; no fractions and no empty value |
| `auth_reference` | the adjuster authorization reference the day is drawn on | copied character for character from the authorization reference shown on the referral, preserving letters, digits and punctuation with no normalisation |

**Return.** On success the result reads `status` "recorded", together with `wc_event_id` (the reference number of the new program-day entry), `wc_case_id`, `appointment_date`, `units` (the whole hours recorded), `auth_reference`, and `authorized_visits_remaining` (the authorized program days still unused on the referral after this day). The program day is then visible in the referral history with the recording date set to today.

## Questions on the tool

**Does recording a program day bill the carrier?** No. Nothing is billed by this action.

**What happens to the authorized balance?** It goes down by one program day for each day recorded.
